cc:Work.dc:title: G2 · paired full-game differences
cc:Work.dc:description: fresh_start_v1 · completed greedy exact-argmax full-game DEV evaluation · all 4,096 paired seeds per contrast. Direct paired difference estimates and 95% whole-WORLD bootstrap CIs from strict comparison JSONs. Win NI margin: 1 percentage point only. Mean floor has no margin. Greedy evaluation is not stochastic training game win rate; no gate verdict is assigned here. ◇ = degenerate empirical bootstrap (constant observed contrast); it does not imply zero population uncertainty.

g.text: fresh_start_v1 · completed greedy exact-argmax full-game DEV evaluation · all 4,096 paired seeds per contrast.
Direct paired difference estimates and 95% whole-WORLD bootstrap CIs from strict comparison JSONs. Win NI margin: 1 percentage point only.
Mean floor has no margin. Greedy evaluation is not stochastic training game win rate; no gate verdict is assigned here.
◇ = degenerate empirical bootstrap (constant observed contrast); it does not imply zero population uncertainty.
